posts.title: Classic Outlook updates, features, fixes and known issues (mid-November 2026)
posts.description: Classic Outlook received 19 security updates in November 2026 as part of another record-breaking Office security release, with one vulnerability already being exploited. Highlights include ongoing issues with missing public holidays, Service Assisted Search in shared and online mailboxes, and Shared Calendar invitation crashes, plus a fix being rolled out for an issue with the Share Contacts comma

posts.title: How to backup New Outlook Account Configuration and Mailbox Data
posts.description: This is a full backup guide for New Outlook. Learn how to successfully backup and restore your Account Settings, Mailbox data, Calendar and Contacts. Additional preparations and workarounds are needed due to limitations in New Outlook, which could prevent you from being able to recover your Calendar and Contacts.

posts.title: How to Create and Manage Multiple Mail Profiles in New Outlook
posts.description: New Outlook supports multiple Mail Profiles, but the feature is hidden and managed entirely through command-line options. Learn how to create, manage, back up, restore and switch between Mail Profiles in New Outlook.
